displayName: OCI-API-001: API1: Broken Object Level Authorization (BOLA)
description:
Detects sequential or unauthorized access to API objects by ID indicating broken object-level authorization

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_api_001", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%api1%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%broken%') AND "value" > 0
